item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a small letter viewed through three pieces of glass held close to the page: a convex lens (P), a concave lens (Q), and a flat transparent glass piece (R).

How does the letter appear in each case?

options.A: Through P the letter looks erect and enlarged; through Q it looks erect and smaller; through R it looks the same size and shape.
options.B: Through P, Q, and R the letter looks erect and enlarged.
options.C: Through P the letter looks smaller; through Q it looks enlarged; through R it looks inverted.
options.D: Through R the letter looks enlarged, because any clear glass enlarges the letter.
